title: contracts/push.json
description: The app's remote push facts (push-notifications). The server reads the same file.

provider.description: expo: the server sends through the Expo push service with Expo push tokens. native: the server calls APNs and FCM itself with device tokens.

requiresAccount.description: True when the server accepts only registrations of a signed-in account; the registration is then removed by the push-registration server sign-out step.

kinds.description: Every data.kind the app understands; equal to PUSH_KINDS in files.message.

channels.description: The Android channels; ids equal PUSH_CHANNELS in files.channels. Never reuse an id for another behaviour.

defaultChannel.description: Where a push without channelId lands on Android; one of channels, and the expo-notifications plugin's defaultChannel.

server.description: Facts for the server's developers; the checker does not read them.
